# Jamaica --languages_spoken--> Jamaican English
import networkx as nx
evidence_graph = nx.MultiDiGraph()

# Add nodes
evidence_graph.add_node("Jamaica", name="Jamaica", example_id="WebQTest-0")
evidence_graph.add_node("Jamaican English", name="Jamaican English", example_id="WebQTest-0")
evidence_graph.add_node("Jamaican Creole English Language", name="Jamaican Creole English Language", example_id="WebQTest-0")

# Add edges with predicates
evidence_graph.add_edge("Jamaica", "Jamaican English", key="official_language", predicate="location.country.official_language")
evidence_graph.add_edge("Jamaica", "Jamaican Creole English Language", key="languages_spoken_1", predicate="location.country.languages_spoken")
evidence_graph.add_edge("Jamaica", "Jamaican English", key="languages_spoken_2", predicate="location.country.languages_spoken")

print("Nodes:", evidence_graph.number_of_nodes(), "Edges:", evidence_graph.number_of_edges())
for u, v, data in evidence_graph.edges(data=True):
    print(f"{u} --[{data.get('predicate')}]--> {v}")
GRAPH_FINAL(evidence_graph)
